name: saint-sworn
source:
The beasts of our priory are noble. They know their own.

How far would you go to save your queen?  In sweltering lands far from home, a knight makes three choices.

[From [url=https://lapinlunaire-games.itch.io/tyvn]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
我们修道院的野兽都是高贵的。他们知道自己的。

为了拯救你的女王，你愿意走多远？在远离家乡的闷热土地上，骑士做出三个选择。

[来自[url=https://lapinlunaire-games.itch.io/tyvn]itch.io[/url]]
